comment: The site demo video's storyboard: positions and durations, never titles. Compiled by tools/site_video.py (`compile_storyboard`) to the dump driver's key schedule. Virtual time only advances on clean frames, so a duration is a duration of the FILM, and `gates` fails any beat whose picture was still visibly moving 0.2 s before the next beat's key (`gate_beats_at_rest`, on decoded frames). Rests under 1.4 s on a card keep the hold-hint capsule (1.5 s of settled rest) out of the film. The profile chip is on the route up to the tab bar (up from the hero lands on it), so the harness signs the simulator in to the mock's Demo account and the chip reads Demo, never Sign in. Loop: the last frame is the first frame's composition (Home, hero, focus on Continue).
